newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto gold stocks follow bullion price down.
newsitem.headline: Toronto gold stocks follow bullion price down.

text.p: Investors bailed out of Toronto gold stocks in the first hours of trading on Monday as the price of gold bullion slipped.
Placer Dome Inc was down C$0.60 to C$32.30 and Barrick Gold Corp fell C$0.50 to C$36.70 in fairly heavy mid-morning trading.
TVX Gold Inc was down C$0.45 to C$10.70 in trading of more than 440,000 shares.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's gold group, the exchange's most heavily weighted group, was down 1.14 percent.

"There had been some expectations building, that gold was going to recover. Instead it just seems to be lying around, up a bit, down a bit. And lately, down a bit," said analyst Manford Mallory at Research Capital Corp.
London gold fixed at $384.60 per ounce Monday, down from Friday's close of $385.20.
Mallory said jittery investors are ready to sell with every downturn in the gold bullion price.
"The recent weakness is largely worries that higher interest rates will be negative for gold," he said.
"They are certainly negative for gold in the absence of higher inflation."
